allow: Bash(bun -e "import\('dotenv/config'\); const m = await import\('mongoose'\); const { default: User } = await import\('./src/models/User.ts'\); await m.default.connect\(process.env.MONGODB_URL\); const users = await User.find\({}\).select\('_id username onboarded onboardingStatus'\).lean\(\); console.log\(JSON.stringify\(users.map\(u => \({ id: String\(u._id\), username: u.username, onboarded: u.onboarded, currentStep: u.onboardingStatus?.currentStep, hasStatus: !!u.onboardingStatus }\)\), null, 2\)\); await m.default.disconnect\(\);")

PowerShell($envFile = Get-Content .env -Raw; $key = \([regex]::Match\($envFile, '\(?m\)^CAL_API_KEY=\(.+\)$'\)\).Groups[1].Value.Trim\(\); Write-Host "=== Probe: who does this API key belong to? ==="; try { $me = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://api.cal.com/v2/me?apiKey=$key" -Method GET -Headers @{ "cal-api-version"="2024-08-13"; "Content-Type"="application/json" } -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "STATUS: $\($me.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host $me.Content } catch { Write-Host "STATUS: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\)"; try { $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); Write-Host $sr.ReadToEnd\(\) } catch { Write-Host "\(no body\)" } })
